notes: The 'that' at t014 is the presentative frame's complementizer and stays with היה, since the apodosis יַעֲלוּ דְבָרִים opens with no waw of its own (rule 45).
The protasis waw is unrepresented: the ASV writes no connective before 'It shall come to pass', and the clause's two waws are answered by only one written 'and'.

In בַּיּוֹם הַהוּא the single English determiner is carried by the demonstrative pronoun הוּא, so both article morphemes are unrepresented — rule 41's limit, since another morpheme licenses the determiner.
